caption: The drawing features a single object: a lidded metal pot with a long, dark handle, depicted in a monochromatic palette using pencil shading. The pot has a rounded body with a pronounced curved contour, a short spout on the left side, and a flat lid fitted with a round knob at the center. The lid and the top rim of the pot display three distinct horizontal lines, suggesting a layered design. The handle, attached at an upward angle to the right side of the pot, is elongated, tapering, and darkest at the far end, which terminates with a small, round tip. The composition is set against a plain background, enclosed within a thin rectangular border that frames the drawing. The artist's signature, "G. Capelli," appears in the lower right corner within the border.
title: Silver Saucepan with Cover
